source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
display_title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-SSRI-03 Demand-led innovation in security – Horizon Europe
executive_summary: Funds one Pre-Commercial Procurement action in which a buyers' group of security practitioners and public procurers jointly buys research and development services for innovative civil-security technology: a preparation stage, a call for tenders, and a competitive development in phases (design, integration and technical verification, validation in a real operational environment) leading to at least 2 prototypes from 2 different suppliers, reaching TRL 6–8. Beneficiaries must include at least 3 practitioners and 3 public procurers from at least 3 EU Member States or associated countries, of which at least 2 independent public procurers in different countries, one in a Member State; procurement costs are eligible, subcontracted work must be performed in at least 3 Member States, and financial support to third parties of up to EUR 100,000 each may be given to final end-users. Funded at up to 100% of eligible costs; indicative topic budget EUR 5.83 million for 1 project. Forthcoming: planned opening 5 May 2027, single-stage deadline 4 November 2027 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 6, pp. 149–153 (HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-SSRI-03, Specific conditions and Scope), funds a joint pre-commercial procurement in which security practitioners and public procurers buy competing research and development of innovative civil-security solutions, validated in a real operational environment. It touches TenneT's protection of critical grid infrastructure, close to SylWin1 HVDC retrofit (operational security) and TwinEU (grid resilience), provided the buyers' group picks an infrastructure-protection challenge. General Annex B, p. 13, footnote 35, counts contracting entities under Directive 2014/25/EU as public procurers, which in our interpretation includes TenneT TSO B.V., so TenneT could be a funded buyer whose procurement is co-financed at the pre-commercial procurement rate of 100% (General Annex G, p. 31): Type 1, C1.4. Both project dates are null because the topic states no start, end or duration.
